concerns.text: SC-001 is unbacked by a specific plan element. The plan mentions 'execute a static baseline run' and 'execute a CAP-enabled run' but does not explicitly define the task of measuring the 'difference in buffer cycles required to reach [deferred] accuracy' as a distinct output or metric collection step. While implied by the t-test, the specific measurement of the cycle difference itself needs a corresponding plan task or data-model field to ensure it is captured and reported.

SC-002 is a duplicate of SC-001 in the spec text ('difference in buffer cycles...'). The plan does not address this duplicate requirement. If SC-002 was intended to be a different metric (e.g., variance of cycles), it is missing from the spec. If it is a typo, the spec needs correction. The plan currently has no element to address a duplicate or distinct metric for SC-002.

SC-005 requires measuring 'average prompt length... during mid-training steps (defined as the interval from [deferred] to [deferred] of total cycles)'. The plan mentions 'average prompt length' in the summary and data-model, but does not explicitly define the 'mid-training' interval calculation or the task to extract this specific subset of data for the comparison. The plan needs a specific step or data-model field to capture this interval-based metric.
